Titles.jpn: アイカツ スターズ！

Summaries.eng: The series will feature a new protagonist named Yume Nijino. Yume aims to become a top idol, and she enrolls in the Yotsuboshi Gakuen (Four Stars Academy). This academy has a special group called the S4, who are the top four active idols in the school. Yume and the other first-year students aim to become a part of the S4.
Summaries.jpn:
トップアイドルをめざしアイドル活動“アイカツ！”にはげむ少女たちのサクセスストーリー！
『アイカツスターズ！』

アイドル学校である四ツ星学園。
学園のトップスターである4人は“S4”と呼ばれ、アイカツ界で大活躍！
新入生たちは、S4を目標に、アイドル活動にはげみます。

きらめく「アイカツ！カード」にグリッター！
自分らしく輝くためにセルフプロデュース！

強く明るくまっすぐに！
歌やダンスにファッションも！
女の子の憧れを全部つめこんで、新しいアイカツが始まります。

アイドルの一番星に向かって、夢へのスタート！！

Summaries.eng: The film's plot is set in a southern island, where a Legendary Dress Audition is taking place. Nijino Yume and the others must find secret dresses said to be hidden somewhere in the island.

Summaries.jpn: Aikatsu! 5th Anniversary Special

Summaries.eng: Yume Nijino is a first year middle school student who attends the idol school, Four Star Academy as a freshman student. Within the school is an idol group consisting of four idols known as "S4", and within that group is Hime Shiratori who Yume yearns to be partners with. To start this new life, there will be a show on the main stage for all freshman students to compete in. As this is the first stage, Yume is to show herself on that stage!?
Summaries.jpn: 中学一年生の虹野ゆめは、アイドル学校・四ツ星学園の新入生。学園のトップアイドル4人、『Ｓ４』のひとりである白鳥ひめにあこがれる新人アイドルだ。すべてが新しい生活の中、新入生のおひろめステージがかいさいされることに。はじめてのステージで、ゆめが見せるステージとは！？

Titles.eng: The Two of Us are Rivals!

Summaries.eng: At Four Star Academy, there are four performance sets, song sets, acting sets, dance sets and fashion sets and the new students have to think about which set to try and enter. Meanwhile the welcome party for new students is under way and new students must stand on stage as a pair. The outcome of a lottery pairs Yume Nijino and her classmate Laura Sakuraba. The two people can only disagree, will their stage be a success?
Summaries.jpn: 四ツ星学園には歌組・劇組・舞組・美組の４つの組があり、どの組へ入ろうかおのおの考える新入生たち。そんな中、新入生のかんげいパーティーが行われることになり、新入生は２人１組でステージに立たねばならないという。クジのけっか、ゆめは同じクラスの桜庭ローラとペアを組むことに。なにかと意見が合わない２人だが、ステージをせいこうさせることはできるのか…？

Summaries.eng: A Spring Festival has been announced to decide which set the new students belong in. Yume wishes to enter within the Song Class that Hime is in, as the Song Class is the most popular of the four classes. However, Yume makes things rather hard for herself, so she becomes rather negative. But, she is given words of encouragement by many people, which suddenly gives Yume a boost of motivation. Now everyone is waiting for the results that will decide which set they belong in. Which one will they be in--!?
Summaries.jpn: 春フェスこと、組決めオーディションのかいさいが発表された。ゆめは、ひめがいる歌組に入りたいと思っているのだが、歌組は４組の中で一番人気。じしんがないゆめは、どんどんネガティブになってしまう。そんな中、とある人からはげましの言葉をもらい、ゆめはがぜんやる気を取りもどす。みんなが大注目の組決めオーディションのけっかは、はたして――！？

Summaries.eng: To be on Aikatsu! TV is something that brings joy to Yume and Laura. With also the appearance of Hime, things keep motivating them even more. However, it is revealed that they will be working behind the scenes. To Yume this was rather dissapointing to hear, but when she is told to come by early the next morning, she hears her most loved person playing the piano...
Summaries.jpn: アイカツＴＶにさんかできることになり、大よろこびのゆめとローラ。ひめもしゅつえんするとのことで、ますますやる気になっている。しかしふたを開けてみると、さんかといってもそれはうらかたのスタッフとして。ガックリくるゆめだったが、早朝きこえるピアノの音にさそわれて行くと、そこには大すきなあの人がいて……。

Titles.jpn: マイ　ドレスメイク！

Summaries.eng: There is a test that is to be carried out in just one week and it has made its way to Yume and the others. The challenge has to do with the Dance Stage and the costume is to be made under the conditions of a Dress Make. This is Yume's first time doing a Dress Make so when Yozora says the words "the purpose the dress serves", Yume questions how she is going to do her first Dress Make...
Summaries.jpn: 一週間後にテストが行われるとあって、ざわつくゆめたち。かだいはダンスステージであり、かつ、いしょうはドレスメイクしたものであることがじょうけんだという。ゆめは、思うがままに、はじめてのドレスメイクをする。しかし、夜空が言う『ドレスが持つ使命』という言葉に、どうすればいいのかまよってしまい……。

Summaries.eng: S4 has announced that they will star in a production of a drama called "ROCK! Rock Girls", which causes Yume Nijino and the other idols of Four Star Academy to cause an uproar. However, the student officers have set up an audition to select three students among the first years to join the drama. Yume, Laura and Koharu are all motivated to pass the audition and co-star with S4. However, who will be the three people to pass the audition!?
Summaries.jpn: Ｓ４の四人がしゅえんをつとめるドラマ『ガリギャル』のせいさくが発表され、虹野ゆめたち四ツ星学園のアイドルはおおさわぎ。しかもせいと役を１年生の中からオーディションでえらぶという。ごうかくすればＳ４ときょうえんできるとあって、ゆめ、ローラ、小春はやる気まんまん。はたして、３人はオーディションにごうかくできるのか――！？

Titles.jpn: シンプル　イズ　ザ　ベスト

Summaries.eng: This Spring, an ice cream company known as "Jewel Ice Cream" is looking for the "Unique Idol". Being attracted to the word "unique", Laura decides to become a candidate. When she does some research on the personality of being this idol, she realizes something. What is the personality to be this idol? The more Laura thinks about it, the more she doesn't understand, so she decides to try and reach for her own individuality...
Summaries.jpn:
この春できたアイスクリーム会社『ジュエルアイスクリーム』が、『こせいてきなアイドル』をぼしゅうしているという。『こせいてき』という言葉にひかれ、われこそはとりっこうほするローラ。
こせいについて色々と研究するも、はたと気づく。こせいってなんだろう？考えれば考えるほど、分からなくなってしまうローラ、はたしてローラがたどり着くこせいとは・・・

Summaries.eng: Yozora Kasumi from S4 has notified the first year Moon Beauty students about a contest for fashion models. After her attempt on the large stage, Koharu is quite nervous. With their lessons used for production time, everyone is in the same class from midday. With Koharu having no faith in herself, she begins to lose all of her self-confidence...
Summaries.jpn: Ｓ４の香澄夜空から、美組１年生たちにファッションモデルのコンテストがこくちされる。ひごろのせいかがためされる大ぶたいとあって、小春はかなりきんちょう気味。本番に向けてレッスンするもうまくいかず、同じクラスの真昼とのさもれきぜん。落ちこむ小春は、じしんをなくしてしまい……。

Summaries.eng: Yume and Laura are to play in the Campaign Girl Audition for the famous sweets shop, Saiwai Hanando. The president of Saiwai Hanando says that she wants new products related to "sea bream baked in miracles" as she is looking for miracle idols. Intelligence, physical fitness is what those lucky enough need to pass the audition. Overcoming a number of things, who will become the splendid Campaign Girl...!?
Summaries.jpn: ゆめとローラは、有名わがし屋・幸花堂のキャンペーンガールオーディションに出場することに。幸花堂社長いわく、新商品の『ミラクルめで鯛焼き』にちなみ、きせきを起こすアイドルをさがしているという。知力、体力、そして運を持つ者がごうかくできるというこのオーディション。数々のしれんを乗りこえ、見事キャンペーンガールのざを勝ち取るのは一体だれ……！？

Titles.jpn: ゆめのスタートライン！

Summaries.eng: One day, Yume is suddenly issued to do the school's office. Since Hime's originally planned live was cancelled, Yume is told to perform her first live instead. Yume is ecstatic but not all of the tickets were sold out. In these severe circumstances, Yume wonders if she will succeed on the big stage...
Summaries.jpn: ある日、ゆめはとつぜん学園長によび出される。なんと予定していた白鳥ひめのライブが中止になったため、代わりにゆめのファーストライブを行うのだという。うちょうてんのゆめだったが、ふたを開けてみるとチケットが全く売れていない。きびしいじょうきょうの中で、ゆめはこの大きなステージを成功させることはできるのか……？

Titles.eng: Stuck To! A Day with Hime Shiratori

Summaries.eng: Yume Nijino of Four Star Academy is told to serve the top idol Hime Shiratori as her manager for one day. Due to being close to Hime, Yume gets to accompany her to her program, in which she once again sees the proof of "Hime being a prodigy". However, the program director seems to be worried about something...
Summaries.jpn: 四ツ星学園の虹野ゆめは、あこがれのトップアイドル白鳥ひめの１日マネージャーをつとめることとなった。ひめのみっちゃく番組に同行する中で、かのじょのすごさを目の当たりにしたゆめは、「ひめ先輩は天才」だとあらためて感じるのだった。だが、番組ディレクターに気になることを言われて…。

Titles.jpn: はばたくガールフレンド♪

Summaries.eng: Yume Nijino and the others have been living in the dormitories for days, when they receive a strict yet friendly call from Tsubasa Kisaragi, member of S4 and the school's student council president. Meanwhile, a first year has found a pet and brought it in. The dormitories ban pets and as this first year broke the rules, Tsubasa is rather angry yet she doesn't seem worried about it at all.
Summaries.jpn: りょうで生活するゆめたちは日々、Ｓ４でありせいと会長でもある如月ツバサからきびしくもやさしいしどうを受けていた。そんな中、１年生がかくれてペットをかっていることがはんめいする。りょう内はもちろんペットきんし。きそくをやぶった１年生に対し、ツバサは今までいじょうにないほどおこっていて…。

Titles.jpn: リトルフェアリー物語

Summaries.eng: At least once a year Four Star Academy holds a festival called "Four Star Film Festival", in which this year, an original movie starring Yume and the others called "Little Fairy Story" will be shown. Using a lottery system, Yume is selected for the leading role. The shooting of the film has somehow finally came to an end and the day for the festival has finally arrived. What is the final product for this kind of movie--!?
Summaries.jpn: １年に一度開かれる『四ツ星映画祭』で発表するオリジナルえいが、『リトルフェアリー物語』にしゅつえんすることになったゆめたち。くじ引きのけっか、なんとゆめが主役にえらばれる。なんとかさつえいはしゅうりょうし、今日は待ちに待ったえいが祭の本番。はたして、どんなえいがに仕上がったのか――！？

Summaries.eng: S4's Yozora Kasumi's program has an idea of recruiting a Stage Dress. Having heard that there will be a special live for whoever has the best dress, Yume and the others are motivated to attempt this as they overflow with determination. Mahiru Kasumi from the first year Beauty Class hears this and for reason has a stern look on her face--.
Summaries.jpn: Ｓ４の香澄夜空の番組で、ステージドレスのアイデアをぼしゅうするという。また、さいゆうしゅうドレスにえらばれるととくべつにライブができると聞いて、ゆめたちはぜったいにおうぼしようとやる気まんまん。その話を聞いた美組１年生の香澄真昼は、なぜかけわしい顔で――。

Summaries.eng: An implementation for a proficiency test has been announced for the first years. Furthermore, one student from each class will be selected to participate in the Summer Festival as a unit with S4. Test results of their abilities come back and Mahiru Kasumi is the first to be selected for the Beauty Class. Everyone thought she would be happy but her facial expression is firm, saying "I will definitely not lose to my sister"...
Summaries.jpn: １年生に実力テストのじっしが発表される。また、かく組で１いになったせいとは、Ｓ４とユニットを組み夏フェスに出場できるという。実力テストのけっか、美組の１いとなった香澄真昼は、よろこんでいると思いきや、そのひょうじょうはかたく、「姉にはぜったいに負けない」と言い放ち…。

Titles.jpn: ミラクル☆バトンタッチ

Summaries.eng: It is the second day of the Summer Festival, and Laura Sakuraba will stand on the stage as the representative for the first years from the Flower Song Class in the very same location where the CM was shot. The schedule for Laura's performance was supposed to be on time, but there is trouble with the equipment. It is impossible for Laura to leave the set, so how will Laura be able to get back to the school after her turn--!?
Summaries.jpn: 夏フェス２日目、歌組１年の代表としてステージに立つ予定の桜庭ローラは、ＣＭさつえいのロケげんばにいた。出番に間に合うスケジュールだったはずが、なんときざいトラブル！げんばをはなれられなくなってしまうローラ、はたして出番までに学園にもどることができるのか――！？

Summaries.eng: The quartet, Yume Nijino, Laura Sakuraba, Koharu Nanakura and Ako Saotome will make a guest appearance on the popular variety program for M4, and they hope they are ready for it. But Ako, only longs for Subaru Yūki who seems rather worried, as she appears to have forgotten her role as an idol...
Summaries.jpn: 虹野ゆめ、桜庭ローラ、七倉小春、早乙女あこの４人は、Ｍ４の人気バラエティ番組にゲストしゅつえんすることになり、気合い十分。しかしあこは、あこがれの結城すばるのことばかりが気になって、アイドルとしての役目をわすれてしまっているようで…。

Summaries.eng: It is announced that anyone who is a first year is to be implemented into a fan voting. The top 4 idols of this vote will have to stand on the opening stage for the summer event, "Aikatsu☆Island". While everyone strives for no accidents to occur, Yume has seemed to have found a new Aikatsu...?
Summaries.jpn: １年生全員がさんかするファンとうひょうのじっしが発表される。ここでじょうい４人に入ったアイドルは、夏のイベント『アイカツ☆アイランド』のオープニングステージに立てるという。みんながじこアピールにはげむ中、ゆめが見つけた新たなアイカツとは…？

Titles.jpn: 真夏のトップダンサー☆

Summaries.eng: The 2nd year S4 member Yuzu Nikaidō, is to compete in a dance competition at Japan's highest level. Yuzu safely qualifies, but she is no where to be found before the final round. Yume and the dance executives, look for her around the venue. Where has Yuzu, the idol who is always too free, gone too--!?
Summaries.jpn: Ｓ４ゆいいつの２年生・二階堂ゆずが、国内さいこうほうのダンス大会に出場するという。ぶじよせんをつうかしたゆずだったが、決勝せんの直前、行方知れずになってしまう。会場をさがしまわる、ゆめや舞組かんぶたち。自由すぎるアイドル・ゆずの行方は、一体どこ――！？

Summaries.eng: Yume, Laura, Koharu and S4 are going to shoot a movie that they will appear in. To Tsubasa, being exhausted is a curse, which makes her director complain. Meanwhile, the stunt people do not come. At this rate, the release of the movie will be cancelled. Within this pinch, one idol stands up--!
Summaries.jpn: ゆめ、ローラ、小春は、Ｓ４がしゅつえんするえいがのさつえいげんばの見学に行くことに。かんぺきなえんぎをひろうするツバサに対し、なぜかしゅえんはいゆうはもんくをつけるのであった。そんな中、スタントの人が急きょ来られなくなってしまう。このままでは、えいがの公開は中止。このピンチに、一人のアイドルが立ち上がる――！

Titles.eng: Feeling of the Desire to Win

Summaries.eng: All first years from Four Star Academy's Flower Song class are to take an audition over a CD debut. This is a big chance in their eyes, so as rivals, Yume Nijino and Laura Sakuraba tackle the harsh lessons together. However, they overlook each other's skills because when that result is shown, "You better not have hard feelings for whoever wins"--?
Summaries.jpn: ＣＤデビューをかけて、オーディションを受けることになった四ツ星学園の歌組１年生たち。ビッグチャンスだと、きびしいレッスンに取り組むライバルどうしのゆめとローラ。「どっちが勝ってもうらみっこなし」とちかい合いしんさにのぞむが、はたしてけっかは――！？

Titles.eng: Longing for the Road of Continuation

Summaries.eng: Yume has passed the audition, and now she is filled with so much motivation to create an amazing CD. But, her release date clashes with the release date of Hime Shiratori's CD, who is one of the S4 members. Even though Laura and Koharu worry about her, Yume proceeds to prepare for the date without worrying but...
Summaries.jpn: オーディションにごうかくしたゆめは、すてきなＣＤを作り上げようとやる気まんまん。しかしなんと、ゆめのＣＤ発売日と、Ｓ４の一人、白鳥ひめのＣＤ発売日が重なっているという。心配するローラと小春をよそに、ゆめは気にせずじゅんびを進めるが…。

Summaries.eng: "The Lucky Seven of Four Star Academy" is where if you collect every wish, something will come true! Yume and Laura, start looking for these wishes, but they can't find the seventh "Tundra Songstress" who is nowhere to be found. Meanwhile, Yuzu Nikaidō of S4 is at an event, and announces that her show is going to be replaced by another idol who is about to make a guest appearance.
Summaries.jpn: 全部集めるとねがいがかなう『四ツ星学園の七つのラッキー』！ゆめやローラたちは、ねがいをかなえようとさがし始めるのだが、七番目の『ツンドラの歌姫』がどうしても見つからない。そんな中、Ｓ４の二階堂ゆずのイベントに、とあるアイドルがゲストしゅつえんするという。

Summaries.eng: For the first time ever, Yume, Laura, Mahiru and Koharu are invited to "Rainbow Pastry Shop" which is actually Ako's home. Everyone eats some sweets, and as Yume watches an album of someone's early childhood, the next door neighbor, Reina comes in saying "I want to bake a cake together"...
Summaries.jpn: はじめてオフをもらったゆめは、ローラ、小春、あこ、真昼を実家の「なないろ洋菓子店」にしょうたいする。みんなでスイーツを食べたり、ゆめがおさないころのアルバムを見たりしていると、近所の女の子・レイナが、「いっしょにケーキを作ってほしい」とやって来て…。

Titles.jpn: ブロードウェイ☆ドリーム

Summaries.eng: Tsubasa Kisaragi from S4 describes the main event of this festival to be "Broadway Dream". On the stage for a dance show, people are hard at work behind the scenes doing things like creating a production and doing a certificate course, which is all being done for one student. As this is their first time experiencing something like this, Yume and the others excitement levels will not drop--!
Summaries.jpn: Ｓ４の如月ツバサから、学園祭のメインイベント『ブロードウェイドリーム』についてのせつめいがある。ショーダンスのステージで、しゅつえんするだけでなく、しょうめいやえんしゅつなどのうらかた仕事まで、すべてせいとだけで作り上げるのだという。はじめてのけいけんに、ワクワクが止まんないゆめたちで――！

Titles.eng: A Dream That Can't Be Taken

Summaries.eng: One of the members of S4, Yuzu Nikaidō appears to be in a good mood for some reason. And that reason is because Lilie Shirogane, the "Songstress of Tundra" is coming back to the school. Lilie is a second year student in the Flower Song Class, as well as being Yuzu's childhood friend. And in response to her fans, Lily will be having a school-wide come-back live--!
Summaries.jpn: Ｓ４のひとり、二階堂ゆずは何やらゴキゲン。その理由は、『ツンドラの歌姫』と呼ばれる白銀リリィが学園に帰って来るから。リリィは歌組の二年生で、ゆずとはおさななじみ。そんなリリィが、ファンのようぼうを受けて学園ふっかつライブをすることになり――！

Summaries.eng: Yume and Lilie are invited by one of the S4 members, Hime Shiratori to visit the headquarters of the most admired brand, "My Little Heart". There, they get to see, up close, the creation of a Premium Rare Dress, making the two girls very excited. Within that, Yume learn the big goal of Lilie. But.....
Summaries.jpn: ゆめとリリィは、Ｓ４のひとりである白鳥ひめにさそわれ、あこがれのブランド「マイリトルハート」の本部を見学することに。プレミアムレアドレスのせいさくかていを間近で見られるとあって、２人は大こうふん。その中でゆめは、リリィの大きなもくひょうを知るのだが…。

Summaries.eng: Tonight is Halloween, and Four Star Academy is holding a Halloween event. The student who collects the most sweets will be crowned as the Halloween☆Princess. Within the academy, there are a number of stages to clear that have traps set on them. So, who on earth will be the shining princess--!?
Summaries.jpn: 今夜はハロウィンということで、四ツ星学園ではハロウィンイベントがかいさいされることに。おかしを一番多く集めたせいとは、ハロウィン☆プリンセスとしてひょうしょうされるという。学園中にしかけられた数々のステージをクリアし、はえあるプリンセスにかがやくのは一体だれ――！？

Summaries.eng: Every year, there is a soccer world tournament. Yume, Laura and the others have been scheduled to perform for the halftime show. Furthermore, before the finals, an audition has been organised to pick who shall be in the center. Due to this, Laura has a serious expression on her face that she doesn't normally wear...
Summaries.jpn: 毎年行われるという、サッカーのワールドトーナメント。ゆめやローラたちは、そのハーフタイムショーにしゅつえんすることに。また、決勝せんのショーまでに、かく組のセンターを決めるオーディションがあるという。それを知ったローラは、いつになくしんけんなひょうじょうで…。

Summaries.eng: Yume's childhood friend, Koharu has something important to tell Yume, but can't say it. However, she can't stay silent forever. Not wanting to cause too much attention, Koharu decides to say it. Yume is confused about this sudden talk, and realises that it's better to not be sad, so she and Laura decide to come up with a plan for Koharu.
Summaries.jpn: ゆめのおさななじみである小春は、ゆめに大事なことを言えないでいた。しかし、いつまでもだまってはいられない。意を決して、それをつたえる小春。とつぜんの話にとまどうゆめだったが、悲しんでいる場合じゃないと、小春のためにローラたちといっしょにとある計画を立てる。

Summaries.eng: Four Star Academy announces that they will be holding an Autumn festival. The event's theme is "A unit of three", which is said to help form a unit, even if the members are in different classes or are different ages. After hearing this announcement, Mahiru Kasumi, a first year student in the Moon Beauty Class decides to aim high. In response to Mahiru, Tsubasa Kisaragi from S4 gives her a suggestion.
Summaries.jpn: 諸星学園長から、秋フェスのかいさいが発表される。イベントのテーマは『３人ユニット』で、学年・組のわくをこえてユニットを組むことがかのうだという。この発表にむねを高鳴らせる美組１年生・香澄真昼。そんな真昼に対し、Ｓ４のひとり如月ツバサがあるていあんを持ちかける。

Summaries.eng: Yume Nijino, a first year in the Song class, is suddenly chosen to form a unit with Yuzu Nikaidō, a member of S4, for the Autumn festival. Ako Saotome, a first year in the Drama class is also chosen. Both Yuzu and Ako are ready to perform however, Yume is having anxiety about failing on stage again...
Summaries.jpn: 歌組１年生・虹野ゆめは、とつぜん、Ｓ４のひとり二階堂ゆずから秋フェスのユニットメンバーにさそわれる。もう一人は、劇組１年生の早乙女あこ。やる気まんまんのゆず＆あこに対し、ゆめはまたステージでしっぱいしてしまうのではないかとふあんな気持ちでいっぱいで…。

Summaries.eng: Laura Sakuraba, a first year student in the Song Class, can't help but wonder why she can't win against Yume. Before she can figure it out, she gets asked if she could accept a job for the academy. And this job is all about supporting Lilie Shirogane, a second year student in the Song Class. What is this new feeling Laura feels when she watches Lilie's Aikatsu! routine--?
Summaries.jpn: 歌組１年生・桜庭ローラは、なぜゆめに勝てないのか、思いなやんでいた。そんな中、学園長から地方の仕事を受けてくれないかとたのまれる。その仕事ないようとは、歌組２年かんぶ・白銀リリィのサポート。リリィのアイカツ！を間近で見る中で、ローラがいだいた新たな想いとは――？

Titles.jpn: おしゃれガールレッスン

Summaries.eng: As Mahiru is offered her own regular feature in a fashion magazine, she comes across two rude ganguro high school girls, Motoko and Eiko, scolding them for littering. The next day, the girls and their leader, Sumiko, come to Mahiru for advice on how best to wear make-up. With her various hair and make-up tips, Mahiru manages to help the girls show off their true beauty without excessive products. As Mahiru becomes inspired to use her magazine feature for make-up lessons, she further trains the three girls to be her models at a fashion show showing off their transformations.
Summaries.jpn: 今や人気モデルのひとりとなった真昼は、『アイカツスタイルガールズ』でれんさいページを持つことに。自分らしいこせいてきなページにしようと意気ごむ中、ガングロ女子高生３人組に出会う。きょうれつな外見のかのじょたちは、真昼におしゃれを教えてほしいとおねがいするが…！？

Summaries.eng: Still worried about her power kicking in, Yume asks Hime for a full explanation about what is happening to her. Hime explains how Hotaru was the first to develop this power, the side effects of which led to her losing her voice and suddenly retiring. Having noticed Hotaru's suffering more than anyone else, Moroboshi noticed the symptoms in both Hime and Yume and took it upon himself to stop them ending up the same way. Becoming more afraid upon hearing this, Yume confides about her power to Rola, who encourages her to become a stronger rival. The next day, Moroboshi suddenly tasks Yume with appearing as a surprise guest in Hime's concert, serving as a trial to help her overcome her ordeal with her own strength. Noticing her fear about going up on stage, Hime gives Yume her Premium Rare dress to encourage her. Although Yume makes it through the performance without relying on her power, she remains worried as to whether she'll be able to sing on her own.
Summaries.jpn: ふしぎな力について、ひめから話を聞くゆめ。このままでは、もしかしたら歌えなくなるかもしれない。そう思うと、ゆめはステージに立つのがこわくて仕方がない。そんなゆめに、学園長はひめのソロステージのサプライズゲストとして、ステージに立つよう言い放ち――！

Summaries.eng: Moroboshi arranges for Yume to hold a solo concert, threatening to expel her if she cannot satisfy 90% of the audience. As Yume feels her back up against the wall, Hime sends her to a flower shop run by Hotaru. Hotaru explains her experiences with her power and how it led to her losing her voice, regretting that she never appreciated her own natural talent. Reminded of the self-confidence that comes from the support of others, Yume seeks out help from her friends to prepare for her concert and soon returns to her normal self. With everyone's support, Yume manages to perform a successful concert under her own ability, overcoming her need to rely on her power and managing to clear Moroboshi's conditions.
Summaries.jpn: ゆめは、『ふしぎな力』のこわさをぬぐい切れず、いまだ一人でステージに立てないでいた。そんなゆめに、学園長がむちゃなかだいを出す。しかし、これに立ち向かうほか道はない。ゆめは、このきびしいしれんを乗りこえることができるのか…！？

Summaries.eng: The admins prepare to hold a party for Christmas Eve with a stream of S4's concert, encouraging Yume to put on a performance of her own alongside Rola, Mahiru, and Ako. After checking with M4's plans, the girls manage to set up their concert at the shopping district. After everyone's individual events turn out successfully, Subaru starts to develop feelings for Yume.
Summaries.jpn: クリスマスが近くなりウキウキなゆめは、ローラ、真昼、あこといっしょにクリスマスライブをかいさいすることに。会場さがしやチラシ作りなど、すべてをセルフプロデュースするゆめたち。全力でまちじゅうをかけぬけるゆめは、かくじつにせいちょうしている。たくさんのえがおでかざられたクリスマスライブが、ここにまくを開ける――！

Titles.jpn: アイカツニューイヤー!

Summaries.eng: After hosting a New Year's show, the S4 girls look back on how Yume and the others have grown over the past year, contemplating who is likely to be chosen for the upcoming S4 Selection. After visiting the shrine with her friends, Yume is invited to have tea with Hime, who shows her the Tree of Bonds that represent the bonds between S4 members.
Summaries.jpn: 四ツ星学園にも、お正月がやってきた。元日の生放送番組にしゅつえんしたり、はつもうでに出かけたりと、お正月をまんきつするゆめたち。そして、今年のもくひょうは『Ｓ４になること』だと、あらためてちかい合う。今年はきっとすてきな年になる――。それぞれがそう信じ、新たな一年をスタートさせるのであった。

Titles.eng: Four Star Academy, in a Crisis!?

Summaries.eng: Overhearing a conversation between Moroboshi and Anna about the school being in financial crisis, Lily offers to represent Yottsuboshi Academy in a Russian brand designer contest which is offering a sponsorship for the winner. As Lily clears all the challenges ahead of her and reaches the final three, she starts to develop a fever but refuses to retire from the running. Having been concerned for her health, Yume and Rola make their way through snowy weather to deliver some medicine and coffee to Lily, giving her the energy to complete a design for the final round and win the contest. Two weeks later, Lily launches her new brand, Gothic Victoria, with Yume and the others helping to get her shop ready for its opening day. However, she decides to wait to make a Premium Rare Dress until she becomes a member of S4.
Summaries.jpn: 学園長から明かされる、しょうげきの事実。なんと、とある理由で、学園がそんぞくのききにおちいっているという。このききをかいひするほうほうはただ一つ、新たなスポンサーを見つけること。そこで白羽の矢が立ったのは、二年生かんぶの白銀リリィ。果たしてリリィは、学園のききをすくうことができるのか…！？

Titles.jpn: プリンセスダイヤを追え!!

Summaries.eng: The girls star in yet another drama, titled Aikatsu Detectives! The Princess Diamond Incident. As phantom thieves known as the Shadow Stars plot to steal Hime's Princess Diamond, Ako joins Tsubasa, Yuzu, Yozora, and Mahiru as part of an investigation team guarding the diamond at a party. Despite detectives being place everyhere, the diamond gets stolen under everyone's noses, which Tsubasa quickly deduces wasn't the work of the Shadow Stars. As witnesses are questioned, Ako notices that Yuri shouldn't have been able to legibly write a poster after her right hand was injured during the theft, deducing that she is the real thief. Yuri attempts to escape but is thwarted by Ako and Tsubasa, later discovering that the Shadow Stars had manage to steal the diamond from her. Despite this, Ako is praised by Tsubasa for her efforts.
Summaries.jpn: あこが新人けいじ役でしゅつえんしたスペシャルドラマ『アイカツ！刑事（デカ） プリンセスダイヤ事件』がついに放送！あこがちゃくにんしたそうさいっかにとどいたのは、一まいのよこくじょう。それは、三人組の女かいとうシャドウスターズからのものだった。ねらったえものはのがさないというかのじょたちを、今度こそはたいほすると意気ごむけいじたちで――！

Summaries.eng: The school holds the Star Catching Festival, in which each class must use their talents to win different areas by earning votes from the townsfolk. As each of the classes win areas in different ways, the event culminates in a tiebreaker performance between Tsubasa and Yozora. Although the weather gets cloudy halfway through, Yozora manages to use her performance to fill the sky with stars and a dazzling moon to win the festival for the Beauty Class.
Summaries.jpn: 学園長から冬フェスのかいさいが発表される。今年の冬フェスは、題して『星取りフェスティバル』。歌組、劇組、舞組、美組が、四ツ星学園のあるきらきら市をぶたいに、様々なパフォーマンスをひろうし合い、勝負するのだという。自分の組のしょうりをちかい合い、今ここに、アツきたたかいのひぶたが切って落とされる――！

Summaries.eng: Yuzu decides that whoever can keep up with her dancing will be her partner in a music video, but no one in the Dance Class is able to keep up with her.
Summaries.jpn: 四ツ星学園せんぞくのレコード会社、四ツ星レーベルでは、定期てきに舞組のミュージック・クリップを作っている。今回はしゅこうをかえて、舞組Ｓ４の二階堂ゆずともうひとりのダンスペアでいきたいのだという。果たして、ゆずのダンスについていけるアイドルは見つかるのか――！？

Titles.eng: The Chocolate and Song That are Full of Feelings☆
Titles.jpn: チョコっと歌にこめる想い☆

Summaries.eng: Yume Nijino, first-year student of Song Class in Four Star Academy, gets an offer to perform in "The Best Music Show", a popular TV show. Thinking this is the chance to get herself known around the world, Yume gets all fired up. But, Subaru Yūki, the idol who is going to co-star with Yume, says something unusual to her....
Summaries.jpn: 四ツ星学園・歌組１年生の虹野ゆめに、ろうにゃくなんにょに大人気の番組『ザ・ベストミュージックショー』のしゅつえんオファーがまい込んだ。自分を世の中の人に知ってもらえる大チャンスとあって、ゆめはやる気まんまん。そんなゆめに、きょうえんする予定のアイドル・結城すばるが気になることを言ってきて…。

Summaries.eng: Due to the fact that the S4 Selection that is coming up in Spring is getting closer, Laura Sakuraba, first-year student of the Song Class, becomes nervous. She is doing all she can do, but still feels like she is lacking something.... Mahiru Kasumi, first-year student of the Beauty Class, also feels the same thing. Together, thinking that being on the stage is the closest shortcut to their growth, they form a group to open an event...!
Summaries.jpn: 春に行われるＳ４せんを間近にひかえ、歌組１年生の桜庭ローラはあせっていた。やれることはやっている。でも、何かが足りない気がする…。その気持ちは、美組１年生の香澄真昼も同じだった。そんな２人は、ステージに立つことがせいちょうへの一番の近道だと、ユニットを組みイベントをかいさいしようとほんそうする――！

Summaries.eng: Ako Saotome, first-year student of the Theater Class, is thinking about getting her own special dress. To do that, she needs to be successful on a big stage and get a special grade up glitter. But, there is no stage that is free inside or outside the academy. After a lot of effort, Ako finally finds a free stage, but...?!
Summaries.jpn: 劇組１年生の早乙女あこは、自分だけのとくべつなドレスを手に入れたいと考えていた。そのためには、大きなステージを成功させ、とくべつなグレードアップグリッターを手に入れなければならない。それなのに、学園内も外部しせつも全く会場の空きがない。どりょくのすえ、やっとのことで、会場を見つけたあこだったが――！？

Summaries.eng: Finally, Four Star Academy's biggest event, the "S4 Selection", has begun. First year Ako Saotome of the Theatre Class asserts her goal of beating the current S4 and becoming the new S4. The feeling is the same for Yume and the other first years. Using all of her power, Ako challenges current S4 member Tsubasa Kisaragi.
Summaries.jpn: ついに、四ツ星学園の一大イベント『Ｓ４決定戦』が始まる。劇組１年生の早乙女あこは、今のＳ４を打ちやぶり新Ｓ４のざにつくことがもくひょうだと言い切る。その気持ちは、1年生の虹野ゆめ達も同じ。あこは持てる力を全て出し切り、今のＳ４である如月ツバサにちょうせんする。

Summaries.eng: In the S4 Selection of the Beauty Class, "the first ever sister showdown in the history of Four Star Academy" has garnered great interest. Challenging current S4 member Yozora Kasumi is her very own little sister, first year Mahiru Kasumi. Mahiru has been working hard all this time in order to surpass Yozora. Has the time come for her efforts to finally bear fruit--!?
Summaries.jpn: 美組のＳ４決定戦に、世間は『四ツ星学園しじょうはつの姉妹対決！』と大もり上がり。今のＳ４である香澄夜空にちょうせんするのは、夜空の妹である１年生・香澄真昼。真昼は、夜空をこえるために今までがんばってきた。そのどりょくがついに、実る時が来るのか――！？

Titles.eng: The Song that Only Belongs to Me

Summaries.eng: The S4 Selection of the Song Class begins, with the students to take the stage and perform one after another. Among them, second year admin Lilie Shirogane's stage is quite wonderful. However, having witnessed this performance, first year Laura Sakuraba becomes uneasy...
Summaries.jpn: 歌組のＳ４決定戦が始まり、ぞくぞくとステージでパフォーマンスする歌組生たち。その中でも、２年生かんぶの白銀リリィのステージはすばらしいものだった。しかしかのじょのステージを見て、１年生の桜庭ローラはふあんな気持ちになってしまい…。

Titles.eng: To Become the Number One Star!

Summaries.eng: Finally, the time has come for Yume to take the stage. Challenging the current S4 member Hime Shiratori, in a serious stage in which she's risking everything... Yume is worried, unsure how to go about her performance. In that moment, she receives a phone call from a certain someone. Here and now, Yume shines in her own special way, and the curtain rises upon her full power stage---!
Summaries.jpn: ついに、ゆめがステージに立つ時が来た。今のＳ４である白鳥ひめにちょうせんする、すべてをかけた本気のステージ…どのようにすればよいのか、なやむゆめ。そんな時、とある人物から電話がある。今ここに、ゆめがゆめらしくかがやく、全力のステージのまくが上がる――！

Summaries.eng: The S4 Selection has finished, and the appointment ceremony for the new S4 takes place. After the graduation ceremony, a "Thank you party" from S4?---They hold a meeting, planning a performance to show gratitude to the teachers and students who have supported them. Gratitude... hearing that word, Yume comes up with something.
Summaries.jpn: Ｓ４決定せんはしゅうりょうし、新しいＳ４のにんめい式がとり行われる。そつぎょう式のあと、Ｓ４による『Thank you party♡』――お世話になった先生やざいこう生にかんしゃをこめてステージをひろうする会が行われるという。かんしゃ……その言葉を聞いて、ゆめはあることを思いつく。

Summaries.eng: There comes the sudden arrival of the idol school in the form of a luxurious cruise ship: Venus Ark. The owner of the school and top idol Elza Forte steals away all the attention with the beauty of her Star Premium Coord!
As the threat of Venus Ark looms over the school, Yume and Rola decide to put on a show for the first year students.

Titles.eng: Open Sesame! Obtaining the Wings of Stars!

Summaries.eng: In trying to come up with a dress idea to rival Elza's Star Wings, Yume is told by her brand owner to think about what she herself would enjoy.
Wanting to take back Fuwafuwa Dream from Kirara, Ako sneaks into their headquarters with Yume and competes with Kirara to design the brand's new Premium Rare Dress.
Upon arriving at Venus Ark, Yume, Rola, and Mahiru are greeted by Koharu, who explains how she was scouted as a designer by Elza during her studies in Italy.
While doing modelling work, Mahiru hears about a mysterious model known as Shooting Star who vanished from the public eye one day.
Looking to relieve some boredom, Kirara decides to tag along with Yume and Rola as they do a report show on various spots around town.
Koukadou holds another audition for a new campaign unit, which Yume, Lily, Elza, and Kirara all receive invitations to.
As Yume struggles to come up with a Premium Rare Dress for her brand due to her busy schedule, Koharu decides to hold a fishing contest for a change of pace.

Titles.eng: Stuck To! The World of Elza Forte

Summaries.eng: Yume and the others decide to do a feature on Elza for S4's show, during which they are escorted by a first-year student named Alice Caroll. Just as the feature gets underway, Elza suddenly tells Alice that she is to be expelled at the end of the day due to her declining popularity.
Ako is excited to be starring in a drama alongside Subaru, but struggles to keep her composure in front of him during a confession scene with him.

Titles.eng: The One who Inherits the Stars

Summaries.eng: Tsubasa announces her plans to study abroad before informing Rola that she will inherit Spice Chord on the condition that she pass a series of tests.

Titles.eng: The Hot Wind Blown from The Tundra

Summaries.eng: As S4 are each given surprise one-day jobs for their program, Lily decides to becomes a guide for a fan tour to Suzukaze Plateau in leau of resting at her summer retreat.
With Tanabata approaching, Elza has Rei come out of retirement and resume model work as Shooting Star.
As Rola begins her duties as Spice Chord's muse and works on her own Premium Rare Dress, she and Yume are invited to be part of a Venus Wave event to increase their Aikatsu Ranking.
While preparing for her own performance, Yume comes across a young girl named Saya whose friends keep arguing over which idol is better.

Titles.eng: It's Summer! It's the Pool! Let's Treasure Hunt☆

Summaries.eng: Yuzu decides to hold a treasure hunt at the pool for her Shiny Smile brand's Premium Rare Dress premiere.
Venus Ark prepares to hold its proficiency tests, with Kirara sharing a rumor of a forbidden room on the ship where those who fail their tests are locked away.
While en route to preparations for the newest Aikatsu Island event, Yume, Rola, and Mahiru come across three idols from Starlight Academy; Akari Ozora, Sumire Hikami, and Hinaki Shinjō.
While kayaking in the sea, Yume, Rola, and Koharu get lost in a fog storm and end up on a remote island, where they come across Ichigo Hoshimiya.

Elza tells Koharu that the Venus Ark will be leaving Japan for a tour. Meanwhile, Yume, Rola, and Mahiru, whose exchange programmes aboard the Venus Ark are scheduled to end as a result, assume that they will end up having to part ways with Koharu once again, becoming worried when they can't find her aboard the ship before it departs.
Koharu wants to help Yume design some dresses for Berry Parfait, but can't find the confidence to ask her.
Noticing something off between Yume and Koharu, the other girls learn that they had gotten into an argument about Koharu's dress designs.
Yume and Koharu are scheduled to appear on a children's animal show hosted by Ako, where Kirara also brings her pet sheep, Caroline.
Learning that her parents are finally getting some time off work, Mahiru returns home with Yozora and Asahi to spend some quality family time together.
The girls learn that Hime is passing on her My Little Heart brand to Aria Futaba, an idol who is popular in Finland.

Titles.eng: Put In The Language of Flowers

Summaries.eng: As the Venus Ark returns to Japan, Aria searches around the ship with Yume and Kirara for some surprising Aikatsu.
Elza meets her mother, Yukie Grace Forte. Elza has aspired to be like her since her childhood: she was beautiful, shined as brightly as the sun, the world's top idol.

A Halloween night will be held at Four Star Academy, and the idols of Venus Ark will also participate, making it more hectic than usual. Yume and Koharu make a short plan in order to surprise everyone.

Rei makes a vow to obtain the last set of Star Wings, so that Elza's dream can come true. Putting her confidence and determination forward, she debuts her brand Royal Sword, gaining the final set of star wings, so that the Sun Dress can finally emerge; However, the Sun Dress appears randomly before one of the nine who have obtained star wings.

The students of Yottsuboshi Academy begin the shooting for the television program that they are appearing in. Under a time limit, it was supposed to be a show where one has to find a name card starting with letter "S". An intense punishment game called "Coochy-Coo" awaits those who fail to do so.

Yume is in good spirit to obtain the Sun Premium Dress. Appearing to be resuming her Aikatsu! activities immediately after resting, Yume pushes herself a bit too far and realizes that she no longer has an answer for what her favorite thing about Aikatsu! is. Among these events, she and Aria has been invited to co-star with Hime Shiratori on Hime's program.

Finally, the school festival has arrived to Four Star Academy, This year, the main focus of Four Star's school festival will be the play starring the members of S4. The chosen play is "Romeo and Juliet", rewritten for the students of Four Star. Venus Ark students Rei Kizaki and Kirara Hanazono appear in order to enjoy their time. Lillie also finds a prince.
In order to move up on the Aikatsu Ranking, Kirara has decided to enter the unit event that has extremely high points with Ako.
For the sake of moving up Aikatsu! Ranking, for all the upcoming stages, it will be extremely important to acquire the points from performances.

Titles.eng: Nothing but the Number of Tears

Summaries.eng: In order to move up the Aikatsu! Ranking Rola decides to enter a competition worth a lot of points so that she will have a chance of making the top four.

S4 receive a request to produce this years Christmas festival. Yume and the others come up with ideas for the festival, which include erecting a giant Christmas tree in the town shopping district and performing a show for the shoppers.

S4 realize they have a lot of work to do now that its new year but Yuzu decides to take it on all by herself. After taking on a full day of live program shoots, Yuzu succumbs to the strain and collapses.
Elza, Rei and Kirara talk about the past year and how everyone has grown from their experiences. Yume and Aria hold a concert before everyone gathers at Venus Arc to watch the new year fireworks.
Elza announces that she will be closing Venus Arc after the Aikastsu! Ranking final Tournament, leaving all the idols in distress.
Kirara suggests to Aria that she should enter an upcoming competition to raise her Aikatsu! Ranking, saying she needs to get serious if she wants to win.
The top four candidates for the Aikatsu! Ranking are announced. Yume and Mahiru from Four Star Academy, and Elza and Rei from Venus Arc.

Rei still tries to convince Elza to reconsider closing Venus Arc but to no avail. All the other idols aboard the Arc begin talking of leaving after the way Elza has treated them but Rei tries to convince them to stay.
Mahiru becomes hesitant about facing Elza in the tournament. Yume and the others manage to convince her that she has her own radiance that she can shine with.

Elza announces that she will quit being an idol once she wins the Aikatsu! Ranking Tournament. Rei decides she's had enough of Elza's selfishness. Unable to convince her to change her mind, Rei goes to Yume for help.

With the support of her friends, Yume prepares to take the stage, but before doing so she speaks to Elza. Elza is firm in her belief that a perfect idol can only shine alone, but Yume feels that an idol shines with the power of everyone who supports her and vows to prove it.

As Yume gets used to her new world wide fame, Elza is still adamant she will close Venus Ark. However the other idols refuse to leave and after some protesting, Elza realizes what she needs to do next.

As another school year draws to a close, everyone prepares for the upcoming S4 selection. However, Rola announces that she won't be participating this year as she is planning on moving to England to join a music producer called Black Star.

As the new school year begins, Rola prepares to leave Four star Academy for England. Koharu, Ako and Mahiru help Rola pack her belongings up when Yume shows up. As they discuss the future, both Yume an Rola feel they are forgetting something.
Yume, Rola, Koharu, Mahiru and Ako decide to spend their final vacation together having fun before Rola leaves for England. The girls spend a night in the country and are joined by Yuzu and Lillie.
